text.en: I have failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
text.ko: 나는 평생 수없이 실패했다. 그리고 그래서 성공했다.
text.zh-cn: 我一生中一次又一次地失败，这正是我成功的原因。
text.fr: J'ai échoué encore et encore dans ma vie. Et c'est pour cela que je réussis.

caption.en:

en: I needed to see the end first.

moral.en: The failed line doesn't get erased. The next one lands on it.
moral.ko: 실패한 문장은 지워지지 않는다. 그 위에 다음 줄이 놓인다.

characters: a man in his late 20s, short black hair, thin frame, plain dark jacket

cta.en: Follow @shinsegi.en — a new story every day

scenes.image_prompt: empty basketball court at dawn, dew on asphalt, long shot

narration.en: I have failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed. — Michael Jordan.
narration.ko: 나는 평생 수없이 실패했다. 그리고 그래서 성공했다. — 마이클 조던.
narration.zh-cn: 我这辈子失败了一次又一次。正因如此，我才成功。
narration.fr: J'ai échoué encore et encore. C'est pour ça que je réussis.

scenes.image_prompt: bus stop before sunrise, empty bench, distant figure standing, wide shot

narration.en: I needed to see the end first. So I never started
narration.ko: 끝을 봐야 시작이라고 생각했다. 그래서 아무것도 시작하지 못했다
narration.zh-cn: 我以为要先看到结局才算开始。结果什么都没开始。
narration.fr: Je croyais qu'il fallait voir la fin d'abord. Du coup, je n'ai jamais commencé.

scenes.image_prompt: narrow alley at dawn, folded paper on wet pavement, small figure walking away, long shot

narration.en: I picked up a folded paper in the alley.
narration.zh-cn: 我在巷子里捡到一张折起来的纸。
narration.fr: J'ai ramassé un papier plié dans la ruelle.

scenes.image_prompt: cluttered desk by a window, single sheet of paper, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: On the desk I wrote one line. Then crossed it out.
narration.ko: 책상에 펴 놓고 한 줄 썼다. 곧 지웠다.
narration.zh-cn: 我在桌上写了一行，又划掉。
narration.fr: Sur le bureau j'ai écrit une ligne. Puis je l'ai barrée.

scenes.image_prompt: outdoor stairway at midday, person sitting alone, wide shot

narration.en: On the stairs I read it again. The sentence felt strange.
narration.zh-cn: 坐在楼梯上又读了一遍。句子很陌生。
narration.fr: Sur les marches, je l'ai relu. La phrase sonnait faux.

scenes.image_prompt: city bus interior at dusk, passenger by the window, distant small figure, wide shot

narration.en: At the bus stop I folded it into my pocket.
narration.zh-cn: 在车站我把它折好塞进口袋。
narration.fr: À l'arrêt de bus, je l'ai replié dans ma poche.

scenes.image_prompt: small kitchen at night, single lamp on, figure by the counter, seen from behind

narration.en: That night in the kitchen I unfolded it. The crease stayed.
narration.ko: 밤에 다시 폈다. 접힌 자리가 남았다.
narration.zh-cn: 夜里在厨房又摊开。折痕还在。
narration.fr: Le soir, dans la cuisine, je l'ai rouvert. Le pli restait.

scenes.image_prompt: bedroom drawer open in the evening, folded papers inside, distant figure, wide shot

narration.en: I opened the drawer. Folded papers filled half of it.
narration.ko: 서랍엔 접힌 종이가 반쯤 차 있었다.
narration.zh-cn: 拉开抽屉，折好的纸占了一半。
narration.fr: J'ai ouvert le tiroir. Les papiers pliés en remplissaient la moitié.

scenes.image_prompt: rooftop at dusk, open notebook on low wall, small figure standing, wide shot

narration.en: I still stop at the first line. Then I write from there.
narration.ko: 지금도 첫 줄에서 멈춘다. 거기서 쓴다.
narration.zh-cn: 我仍停在第一行。然后从那里写下去。
narration.fr: Je m'arrête encore à la première ligne. Puis j'écris de là.

scenes.image_prompt: empty street at night, one lit window, distant figure walking, long shot

narration.en: The failed line doesn't get erased. The next one lands on it.
narration.ko: 실패한 문장은 지워지지 않는다. 그 위에 다음 줄이 놓인다.
narration.zh-cn: 写坏的句子不会消失。下一行就压在它上面。
narration.fr: La phrase ratée ne s'efface pas. La suivante se pose dessus.
